input: Find a local debate club for adults

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The user's city, region, or neighbourhood determines which specific clubs are geographically reachable — without it, no real search can begin.
Debate clubs vary widely in format — competitive parliamentary, Oxford-style, casual discussion groups, Toastmasters-style — knowing which format the user wants narrows the search significantly.
Availability constraints (weekdays vs. weekends, daytime vs. evenings) determine which clubs are actually compatible with the user's schedule.
The user's experience level (complete beginner vs. seasoned debater) affects whether they need a beginner-friendly or competitive club.
Topic preferences — politics, philosophy, current affairs, general topics — influence which club culture would be the best fit.
Whether the user is open to in-person only, online, or hybrid clubs changes the entire pool of options available to them.
Understanding what 'done well' means — just finding one option, a shortlist, or actually attending a first meeting — defines how far the plan needs to go.

gold.taskTitle: Find a local adult debate club to join
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate and connect with a debate club in their area that is suitable for adults.

questions.title: What city or neighbourhood are you based in?
questions.description: Identifying the user's location is the essential first step to finding geographically relevant clubs.

questions.title: What debate format appeals to you most?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants competitive parliamentary debate, Oxford-style, casual discussion, Toastmasters, or something else.

questions.title: Which days and times are you free to attend?
questions.description: Establish the user's schedule availability to filter out clubs that meet at incompatible times.

questions.title: How much debate experience do you have so far?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is a complete beginner, casually experienced, or a seasoned debater to match them to the right skill level.

questions.title: What topics or subject areas excite you most?
questions.description: Find out whether the user prefers politics, philosophy, current events, or open-topic debate to match club culture.

questions.title: Are you open to online or hybrid clubs as well?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user requires in-person meetings only, or would also consider virtual or hybrid formats.

questions.title: What does success look like — a list, or attending a first session?
questions.description: Determine whether the user's goal is to compile options to review, or to commit to and attend an actual meeting.
